CONFIRM C0025 — current source confirms the finding. `section_terminator` is compiled with `re.MULTILINE` only, so lowercase valid section headers such as `novelty:` or `verified:` do not terminate the ADMISSIBILITY block. That can cause the parser to consume following sections and silently compute wrong gate failures.

CONFIRM C0016 — current source confirms the finding. The marker regex accepts `ADMISSIBILITY: (note)` but not `ADMISSIBILITY (note):`, because the optional parenthetical is only allowed after the optional colon. That falsely reports all five gates failed for a common section-heading style.

I see no operation-blocking or silently-wrong behavior from this annotation. This should remain rejected/closed as non-bug unless a tool receipt shows a concrete type-check or runtime failure.
